cards.summary: FDA가 원료의약품 제조소 SK Biotek Co., Ltd (Sejong Plant)에 Form 483(관찰사항 2건)을 발행했다. 미생물 계수 시험 축소의 근거와 공정 단계 사이 보관 시간의 기록·확인을 지적했다.

facts.label: 제조소/업체
facts.value: SK Biotek Co., Ltd (Sejong Plant) · FEI 3014286622

key_facts: 관찰 1: 원료의약품 미생물 계수 시험의 간헐(스킵 로트) 시험을 허용하나 과학적 근거·위험평가·과거 자료 분석을 제시하지 못함
관찰 2: 보관 시간 시험을 수립했으나 제조기록서 등 생산 문서에 보관 시간을 기록·확인하지 않음
cards.implication: 2025년 4월 이후 해당 원료의약품 약 [가림] 배치가 미국 시장 출하 승인을 받았다(관찰 1). 공정 단계에서 보관 단계가 필요한지, 기록하는지 원료의약품 제조기록서에서 분명하지 않다(관찰 2). 2024년 11월 이후 약 [가림] 배치가 미국 시장 출하 승인을 받았다(관찰 2).
checks: 시험 주기를 줄인 근거로 과거 자료 분석과 위험평가가 문서로 있는가? (관찰 1)
공정 단계 사이 보관 시간을 제조기록서에 기록하고 한도와 대조하는가? (관찰 2)

observations.deficiency: Your firm's established specifications for the microbial enumeration testing of APlm@ @) (4) permit intermittent (skip-lot) or reduced testing frequency.
observations.detail: However, the firm has not provided adequate scientific justification to support this reduced testing program at your production facility. Specifically, The established specifications for the microbial enumeration testing ofAPI [redacted] state that ifm [redacted] batches all meet the acceptance criteria, the applicable test shall be conducted (4 ow and that the test must be conducted [redacted] However, no documented risk assessment, historical data analysis, or validation study was provided during the inspection to support the conclusion that reduced testing provides equivalent assurance of microbiological quality for the API batches produced at your facility. Since April 2025, approximatel [redacted] batches of the API [redacted] have been approved for release to the U.S. market.
observations.deficiency_ko: 회사가 정한 원료의약품 [가림]의 미생물 계수 시험 규격은 간헐(스킵 로트) 시험이나 시험 주기 축소를 허용한다.
observations.detail_ko: 그러나 회사는 생산 시설에서 이 축소 시험 프로그램을 뒷받침하는 적절한 과학적 근거를 제시하지 않았다. 구체적으로, 원료의약품 [가림]의 미생물 계수 시험 규격은 [가림] 배치가 모두 허용 기준을 충족하면 해당 시험을 [가림] 하고, 시험은 [가림] 해야 한다고 정한다. 그러나 축소 시험이 시설에서 생산한 원료의약품 배치의 미생물 품질에 대해 동등한 보증을 준다는 결론을 뒷받침하는 문서화된 위험평가, 과거 자료 분석, 밸리데이션 시험이 실사 중 제시되지 않았다. 2025년 4월 이후 원료의약품 [가림] 약 [가림] 배치가 미국 시장 출하 승인을 받았다.

observations.deficiency: Your firm has established hold time studies to support the maximum allowable storage duration or hold times for raw materials, intermediates, and finished APIs held between manufacturing steps and stages.
observations.detail: However, the hold times are not documented and verified in the batch record or other production documents. Specifically, Your firm's manufacturing process for the production of the APIs oe 0) includes [redacted] major process stages for each finished API. It is unclear in the API production batch records whether hold steps are required and documented during the process stages. No written procedures or risk assessments were provided during the inspection to justify the lack of hold time documentation and verification to ensure that materials, intermediates, and finished APIs are held at various stages during production and prior to final API packaging without adversely affecting quality attributes, such as purity, microbial limits, and moisture content. Since November 2024, approximatel [redacted] batches of the oe oe have been approved for release to the U.S. market.
observations.deficiency_ko: 회사는 제조 단계와 공정 사이에 보관하는 원료, 중간체, 완제 원료의약품의 최대 허용 보관 기간이나 보관 시간을 뒷받침하는 보관 시간 시험을 수립했다.
observations.detail_ko: 그러나 보관 시간이 제조기록서나 기타 생산 문서에 기록·확인되지 않는다. 구체적으로, 회사의 원료의약품 [가림] 생산 제조 공정은 완제 원료의약품마다 [가림] 주요 공정 단계를 포함한다. 원료의약품 생산 제조기록서에서 공정 단계 중 보관 단계가 필요한지, 기록되는지 분명하지 않다. 물질, 중간체, 완제 원료의약품이 생산 중 여러 단계와 최종 원료의약품 포장 전에 순도, 미생물 한도, 수분 함량 같은 품질 특성에 나쁜 영향 없이 보관되도록 보관 시간 기록과 확인이 없는 것을 정당화하는 문서화된 절차나 위험평가가 실사 중 제시되지 않았다. 2024년 11월 이후 [가림] 약 [가림] 배치가 미국 시장 출하 승인을 받았다.

key_violations.observation: 원료의약품 미생물 계수 시험의 간헐 시험을 허용하면서 위험평가·과거 자료 분석·밸리데이션 시험을 제시하지 못했다(관찰 1).
보관 시간 시험을 수립했으나 제조기록서 등 생산 문서에 보관 시간을 기록·확인하지 않는다(관찰 2).

required_remediation.deadline: 회신은 의무가 아니다. 15영업일 안에 받은 회신은 FDA가 후속 조치를 정할 때 검토한다.

en.summary: FDA issued a Form 483 with two observations to the API manufacturing site of SK Biotek Co., Ltd (Sejong Plant), citing justification for reduced microbial enumeration testing and documentation of hold times between process steps.
en.implication: Since April 2025, batches of the API have been approved for release to the U.S. market (Observation 1). It is unclear in the batch records whether hold steps are required and documented during process stages (Observation 2). Since November 2024, batches have been approved for release to the U.S. market (Observation 2).

Observation 2: hold time studies are established, but hold times are not documented or verified in batch records or production documents

Are hold times between steps recorded in batch records and checked against limits? (Observation 2)

observations.deficiency_ko: 원본 기록이 정확성·완전성·확립된 기준 준수를 위해 검토됐음을 보이는 두 번째 사람의 검토가 미흡하다.

It states that mix-ups of components and products during packaging present an unacceptable risk to patient safety, and that a number of recalls have recently been initiated and several critical deficiencies raised by GMP Inspectors.

cards.summary: FDA가 재포장·재표시 업체 Sagecor Health, LLC에 Form 483(관찰사항 2건)을 발행했다. 재가공 배치의 조사와 제조·관리 기록을 지적했다.
key_facts: 관찰 1: 재가공 배치를 조사하지 않음 — 재가공 절차 WI-082가 재가공 배치에 일탈이 필요 없다고 명시
관찰 2: 재가공마다 배치 제조·관리 기록을 만들지 않았고 기존 재가공 기록이 불완전·부정확
cards.implication: 한 배치는 품질 인원이 밀봉 불량을, 작업자가 표시 문제를 재가공 사유로 서로 다르게 기록했으나 조사하거나 맞추지 않았다(관찰 1). 회사는 2024년 6월 이후 적절한 추적·경향 분석·조사 없이 약 [가림] 배치를 재가공했다(관찰 1). 포장·표시 부품 수량 기록의 불일치와 계산을 회사 인원이 실사 중 설명하지 못했다(관찰 2).
checks: 재가공할 때마다 원인을 조사하는가? (관찰 1)
재가공 사유와 결함 수량을 제조기록서에 한 가지로 기록하는가? (관찰 1)
재가공 때 폐기한 표시재·포장재 수량을 대조하는가? (관찰 2)

observations.deficiency: There is a failure to thoroughly review any unexplained discrepancy and the failure of a batch or any of its components to meet any of its specifications whether or not the batch has been already distributed.
observations.detail: Specifically, your firm does not perform investigations for reprocessed batches. Your firms reprocessing procedure, SOP WI-082, Reprocessing Packaged Drugs, effective date 06/20/2024, Rev. B, specifically calls out that deviations are not required for reprocessed batches, indicating that investigations would not be performed. When actions are taken, they are limited to immediate corrective measures, such as operator coaching, without a documented evaluation of the underlying cause. For example, A. Batch [redacted] of [redacted] Tablets was reprocessed due to improperly sealed foil pouches; however, no investigation was conducted to determine whether the failure resulted from operator error, equipment malfunction, inadequate process controls, or another assignable cause. Additionally, quality personnel documented the reason for reprocessing as a sealing failure, while the operator documented the reason as a labeling issue on the in-process deviation form. The discrepancy was neither investigated nor reconciled, and the batch record does not establish the actual reason for reprocessing. B. Batch [redacted] of [redacted] Tablets was reprocessed due to improperly sealed foil pouches. No investigation was conducted to determine whether the failure resulted from operator error, equipment malfunction, inadequate process controls, or another assignable cause. Your firm lacks assurance that appropriate corrective and preventive actions have been implemented to prevent recurrence of similar failures. C. Batch [redacted] of product [redacted] was reprocessed due to labeling defects and leaking ()(); however, the quantity of units affected by each defect was not recorded. There was no investigation performed as to the cause of the leaking [redacted] and the batch record does not adequately identify the extent of each defect or reconcile the affected units. Furthermore, your firm does not track and trend these events to identify recurring failure modes, assess whether systemic issues are contributing to repeated occurrences, or implement corrective actions. Your firm has reprocessed approximately [redacted] batches since June of 2024 without adequate tracking, trending, or investigations.
observations.deficiency_ko: 배치가 이미 유통됐는지와 관계없이, 설명되지 않은 불일치와 배치나 그 구성 성분이 규격을 충족하지 못한 것을 철저히 검토하지 않는다.
observations.detail_ko: 구체적으로, 회사는 재가공 배치에 대해 조사를 하지 않는다. 회사의 재가공 절차 SOP WI-082 '포장 의약품 재가공'(시행 2024-06-20, Rev. B)은 재가공 배치에는 일탈이 필요 없다고 명시해 조사를 하지 않음을 나타낸다. 조치를 하더라도 근본원인에 대한 문서화된 평가 없이 작업자 코칭 같은 즉시 시정 조치에 그친다. 예를 들어, A. [가림] 정 배치 [가림]은(는) 호일 파우치 밀봉 불량으로 재가공됐다. 그러나 그 실패가 작업자 실수, 설비 오작동, 미흡한 공정 관리, 기타 원인 중 무엇에서 비롯됐는지 판단하는 조사는 수행되지 않았다. 또한 품질 인원은 재가공 사유를 밀봉 실패로 기록했으나 작업자는 공정 중 일탈 양식에 표시 문제로 기록했다. 이 불일치는 조사되거나 맞춰지지 않았고, 제조기록서는 실제 재가공 사유를 확정하지 않는다. B. [가림] 정 배치 [가림]은(는) 호일 파우치 밀봉 불량으로 재가공됐다. 그 실패가 작업자 실수, 설비 오작동, 미흡한 공정 관리, 기타 원인 중 무엇에서 비롯됐는지 판단하는 조사는 수행되지 않았다. 회사는 비슷한 실패의 재발을 막는 적절한 시정·예방조치가 시행됐다는 보증이 없다. C. 제품 [가림] 배치 [가림]은(는) 표시 결함과 [가림] 누출로 재가공됐다. 그러나 결함별 영향 단위 수가 기록되지 않았다. [가림] 누출 원인에 대한 조사가 수행되지 않았고, 제조기록서는 각 결함의 범위를 적절히 확인하거나 영향 단위를 대조하지 않는다. 또한 회사는 반복되는 실패 양상을 찾고, 체계적인 문제가 반복 발생에 기여하는지 평가하거나 시정조치를 시행하기 위해 이런 사건을 추적·경향 분석하지 않는다. 회사는 2024년 6월 이후 적절한 추적, 경향 분석, 조사 없이 약 [가림] 배치를 재가공했다.

observations.deficiency: Batch production and control records are not prepared for each batch of drug product produced and do not include complete information relating to the production and control of each batch.
observations.detail: Specifically, batch production and control records are not generated for each reprocessing event, and existing reprocessing records are incomplete and inaccurate. Examples include, but are not limited to: A. During reprocessing of Batch [redacted] _—_—of [redacted], labels and overwraps were discarded; however, no secondary accountability form was generated as required by procedure, WI-082, Reprocessing Packaged Drugs, effective date 06/20/2024, Rev. B. Instead, the discarded components were documented on the original accountability form, leaving component disposition and reconciliation inadequately documented. B. Packaging and labeling component accountability records for batch [redacted] _—of [redacted] contained discrepancies and calculations that firm personnel were unable to explain during the inspection. As a result, the accuracy and completeness of component accountability could not be verified.
observations.deficiency_ko: 생산한 의약품의 각 배치마다 배치 제조·관리 기록을 작성하지 않으며 각 배치의 생산·관리에 관한 완전한 정보를 담지 않는다.
observations.detail_ko: 구체적으로, 재가공마다 배치 제조·관리 기록이 생성되지 않으며, 기존 재가공 기록은 불완전하고 부정확하다. 예는 다음 등이다. A. [가림] 배치 [가림] 재가공 중 표시재와 외포장이 폐기됐으나, 절차 WI-082 '포장 의약품 재가공'(시행 2024-06-20, Rev. B)이 요구하는 2차 수량 확인 양식이 생성되지 않았다. 대신 폐기된 부품을 원래 수량 확인 양식에 기록해 부품 처분과 수량 대조가 미흡하게 기록됐다. B. [가림] 배치 [가림]의 포장·표시 부품 수량 기록에 회사 인원이 실사 중 설명하지 못한 불일치와 계산이 있었다. 그 결과 부품 수량 확인의 정확성과 완전성을 확인할 수 없었다.

key_violations.observation: 재가공 절차 WI-082가 재가공 배치에 일탈이 필요 없다고 정해 재가공 배치를 조사하지 않고 작업자 코칭 같은 즉시 조치에 그쳤다(관찰 1).
한 배치의 재가공 사유를 품질 인원은 밀봉 불량, 작업자는 표시 문제로 달리 기록했으나 조사하거나 맞추지 않았다(관찰 1).
재가공마다 배치 제조·관리 기록을 만들지 않았고 폐기한 표시재·포장재의 수량 대조를 절차대로 기록하지 않았다(관찰 2).

deep_analysis.inspectional_significance: 회사 인원은 부품 수량 기록의 불일치와 계산을 실사 중 설명하지 못했다(관찰 2).

required_remediation.deadline: 회신은 의무가 아니다. 15영업일 안에 받은 회신은 FDA가 후속 조치를 정할 때 검토한다.

en.summary: FDA issued a Form 483 with two observations to the repackager and relabeler Sagecor Health, LLC, citing investigations and production records for reprocessed batches.
en.implication: For one batch, quality personnel recorded the reprocessing reason as a sealing failure while the operator recorded a labeling issue, and the discrepancy was not investigated or reconciled (Observation 1). The firm has reprocessed batches since June of 2024 without adequate tracking, trending or investigations (Observation 1). Firm personnel could not explain discrepancies and calculations in component accountability records during the inspection (Observation 2).
key_facts: Observation 1: reprocessed batches not investigated; procedure WI-082 states deviations are not required for reprocessed batches
Observation 2: batch records not prepared for each reprocessing event, and existing reprocessing records incomplete and inaccurate
checks: Is the cause investigated each time a batch is reprocessed? (Observation 1)
Is a single reprocessing reason and defect count recorded in the batch record? (Observation 1)
Are discarded labels and overwraps reconciled during reprocessing? (Observation 2)

en.title_issue: One finding at a radiopharmaceutical site
en.summary: MFDS (Seoul Regional Office) published the results of a routine GMP inspection of the radiopharmaceutical manufacturing site at Samsung Medical Center, which found deficiencies.
en.implication: The on-site inspection ran from 2026-02-11 to 2026-02-13 (3 days). 'Other' findings are to be corrected, and a GMP certificate is issued once the implementation plan is confirmed as appropriate.
key_facts: Finding 1: quality management, other — separate the person performing tests from the person reviewing and approving results ([Annex 1] 3.1)
Outcome: deficiencies found; sterile radiopharmaceutical injections
Follow-up: corrective action completed
checks: Is the person performing a test different from the person reviewing and approving it? (Finding 1)

en.title_issue: GMP approval revoked for falsified records
en.summary: MFDS revoked the GMP conformity approval of a manufacturer that manufactured differently from its license and repeatedly falsified batch manufacturing records, test logs and certificates of analysis.

Basis: Pharmaceutical Affairs Act Article 38-3(1) and (3)2

key_facts: 위반: 의약품 채택·처방유도·거래유지 등 판매촉진 목적으로 의료기관에 경제적 이익 제공
경위: 2016년 10월경~2019년 3월경 한 의원에 23품목 관련 30회 합계 47,860,000원, 2016년 8월경~2019년 7월경 피부과의원 3곳에 18개 품목 관련 31회 합계 139,600,000원

cards.implication: 이니스트바이오제약(주)는 2021-02-01 (주)비보존제약으로 상호를 바꿨다.

key_violations.citation: 구 ｢약사법｣(법률 제15891호로 개정되기 전의 것) 제47조제2항
key_violations.original: 2016. 10월경부터 2019. 3월경까지 의료기관 ‘연세봄이비인후과의원(서울특별시 서대문구 통일로 448, 4층)’에 ‘데코라펜정(덱시부프로펜)’ 등 23품목(붙임 2 참조)의 채택·처방유도·거래유지 등 판매촉진을 목적으로 총 30회에 걸쳐 합계 47,860,000원의 경제적 이익을 제공하였음. 또한 2016. 8월경부터 2019. 7월경까지 의료기관 ‘초이스피부과의원(신사점)(서울특별시 강남구 강남대로 616, 신사미타워 8층 801호)’, ‘초이스피부과의원(하계점)(서울특별시 노원구 공릉로59길 28, 301호, 302호, 지하2호, 지하7호)’ 및 ‘초이스피부과의원(평촌점)(경기도 안양시 동안구 동안로 128, 3층)’에 ‘더모프레드크림(프레드니카르베이트)’등 18개 품목(붙임 2 참조)의 채택·처방유도·거래유지 등 판매촉진을 목적으로 총 31회에 걸쳐 합계 139,600,000원의 경제적 이익을 제공하였음
key_violations.description: 당시 업체 대표는 2016년 10월경부터 2019년 3월경까지 의료기관 '연세봄이비인후과의원'에 '데코라펜정(덱시부프로펜)' 등 23품목의 채택·처방유도·거래유지 등 판매촉진을 목적으로 총 30회에 걸쳐 합계 47,860,000원의 경제적 이익을 제공했다. 또한 2016년 8월경부터 2019년 7월경까지 '초이스피부과의원' 신사점·하계점·평촌점에 '더모프레드크림(프레드니카르베이트)' 등 18개 품목의 판매촉진을 목적으로 총 31회에 걸쳐 합계 139,600,000원의 경제적 이익을 제공했다(위반 1).

deep_analysis.disposition_basis: 해당 품목 판매업무정지 3개월(2026-12-10~2027-03-09)을 처분했다. 대상은 더모프레드크림, 데코라펜정 등 32품목이다. 이니스트바이오제약(주)는 2021-02-01 (주)비보존제약으로 상호를 바꿨다.
deep_analysis.administrative_risks: 이 처분은 구 ｢약사법｣(법률 제15891호로 개정되기 전의 것) 제47조제2항, 제76조와 구 ｢의약품 등의 안전에 관한 규칙｣(총리령 제1576호로 개정되기 전의 것) 제95조 [별표 8] 행정처분의 기준 Ⅱ. 개별기준 제35호 다목에 따른 것이다.

deterministic_detail.body: DMRC reference number DMRC- 41565600 Marketing Authorisation Holder Mercury Pharmaceuticals Limited Medicine Details Bexarotene 75 mg soft capsules PLGB: 12762/0686 Active Ingredient: bexarotene SNOMED code: 41459011000001108 GTIN: 05021691004929 Affected Lot Batch Numbers Batch No. Expiry Date Pack Size First Distributed 5GJ0551 30/09/2027 100 Capsules 10/04/2026 Background Mercury Pharmaceuticals Limited is recalling Bexarotene 75 mg Soft Capsules, batch 5GJ0551, as a precautionary measure following the identification of several capsules with black/blue spots during additional Acceptable Quality Limit (AQL) testing at the pre-wholesaler’s site. deterministic_detail.body: DMRC reference number DMRC-41456133 Marketing Authorisation Holder Takeda UK Limited Medicine Details PROSTAP PD DCS 1.88 mg powder and solvent for prolonged-release suspension for injection in pre-filled syringe PL: 16189/0038 Active ingredient: leuprorelin acetate SNOMED code: 42797911000001100 GTIN: 07038319160767 Affected Lot Batch Numbers Batch No. Expiry Date Pack Size First Distributed 523373 09/2027 1 pre-filled syringe October 2025 518961 03/2026 1 pre-filled syringe December 2024 Background Takeda UK Limited has identified an error in the administration instructions and labelling for PROSTAP PD DCS 1.88 mg. The product should only be administered by subcutaneous injection. Section 4.2 of the Summary of Product Characteristics (SmPC) states that the product should be administered as a once monthly single subcutaneous injection, and the outer carton also specifies subcutaneous administration. However, Step 5 of the administration instructions in the SmPC and Healthcare Professionals’ User Leaflet incorrectly states that the product can be administered either subcutaneously or intramuscularly. The immediate syringe label also incorrectly states “For SC or IM use after reconstitution’’. This is a labelling defect. No manufacturing, formulation, identity, strength or purity defect has been identified. No confirmed cases of administration by the incorrect route or associated adverse clinical outcomes have been identified for the UK presentation. Available evidence does not indicate serious systemic harm or clinically meaningful loss of efficacy. Takeda UK Limited have classified the expected severity of harm as minor, mainly involving temporary and manageable injection-site reactions. However, direct evidence comparing the pharmacokinetic and pharmacodynamic effects of subcutaneous and intramuscular administration is not available. Due to the requirement for these products to support the UK market, the MHRA in discussion with the Department of Health and Social Care (DHSC) consider that batches which are currently packed and available for distribution, will continue to be distributed until replacement stock becomes available, which is currently anticipated in March/April 2027. Two batches are included within the scope of this notification. Batch 518961 is now expired; however, as it was affected by the same labelling defect, it should remain within the scope of this notification and any associated follow-up review of patients. Takeda UK Limited is progressing corrective regulatory action to ensure that the product information and labelling consistently state the approved subcutaneous route. Advice for Healthcare Professionals PROSTAP PD DCS 1.88 mg should only be given as an injection under the skin (subcutaneous injection). Do not administer the product by intramuscular injection. The affected administration instructions and immediate syringe label incorrectly state that the product may be administered by either the subcutaneous or intramuscular route. Healthcare professionals should continue to prescribe, dispense and administer the product where clinically appropriate, ensuring that it is administered by the subcutaneous route in accordance with the approved product information. The treating paediatric endocrinology team should review the patient’s administration records to confirm the route of administration. Where the records indicate that the product may have been administered intramuscularly, appropriate clinical follow-up should be considered, including confirmation of continued suppression of pubertal progression. Advice for Patients Patients should continue treatment as advised by their healthcare professional. The quality of the product is not affected. This product should be prepared, reconstituted and administered only by healthcare professionals who are familiar with these procedures. The medicine should be given once every month as a single injection under the skin (subcutaneously) and not administered via any other routes. Treatment should not be stopped or changed without advice from the patient’s specialist or another healthcare professional. Patients or carers with concerns should contact their treating healthcare professional. Patients who experience adverse reactions or have any questions about the medication, should seek medical attention. Any suspected adverse reactions should also be reported via the MHRA Yellow Card scheme . Additional information For medical information enquiries please email medinfoemea@takeda.com or telephone 03333 000 181. For stock control enquiries please email ukie.supplychain@takeda.com . Recipients of this Medicines Notification should bring it to the attention of relevant contacts by copy of this notice. NHS regional teams are asked to forward this to community pharmacists and dispensing general practitioners for information. Yours faithfully Defective Medicines Report Centre 10 South Colonnade Canary Wharf London E14 4PU Telephone +44 (0)20 3080 6574 DMRC@mhra.gov.uk Download document Class 4 Medicines Defect Notification: Takeda UK Limited, PROSTAP PD DCS 1.88 mg powder and solvent for prolonged-release suspension for injection in pre-filled syringe, EL(26)A/52

deterministic_detail.body: DMRC reference number DMRC- 41342836 Marketing Authorisation Holder Quadrant Pharmaceuticals Limited (Parallel Import) Medicine Details Brintellix 5 mg Film-coated tablets (incorrectly packed as Brintellix 10 mg Film-coated tablets) PLPI: 20774/2321 Active Ingredient: vortioxetine GTIN (5 mg tablets): 05 060537 816784 GTIN (10 mg tablets): 05 060537 816791 Affected Lot Batch Numbers Batch No. Expiry Date Pack Size First Distributed 2856920/4245Z (MAX 4245Z) 08/2029 28 film-coated tablets 07/10/2026 Background Quadrant Pharmaceuticals Ltd is recalling one batch of Brintellix 5 mg film-coated tablets (mislabelled as 10 mg tablets) due to a labelling error with the product strength impacting an unknown number of units. A number of packs containing Brintellix 5 mg film-coated tablets have been supplied in sealed cartons labelled as Brintellix 10 mg film-coated tablets. Only the parallel imported packs are impacted by this defect. Advice for Healthcare Professionals Check any parallel imported packs of Brintellix 10 mg tablets with the batch number 2856920 and secondary batch number MAX 4245Z. If you are in receipt of these tablets, quarantine all remaining stock and return it to your supplier using your supplier’s approved process. Where possible, patients provided with a parallel imported Brintellix 10 mg pack from this batch should be contacted and told to confirm the strength stated on the tablet blisters matches that on the carton and their prescribed medication. Should a patient be in possession of a pack with the incorrect medicine, pharmacy teams should exercise their professional judgement to supply the correct medication. Should a patient prescribed Brintellix 10 mg inadvertently take Brintellix 5 mg, the clinical risk to the patient is possible reduced effectiveness. This can cause a persistence or worsening of depressive symptoms, recurrence of major depressive episodes and, in susceptible patients, potentially serious deterioration in mental health, including the possible emergence or worsening of suicidal ideation or suicidal behaviour. However, 5 mg is an approved minimum daily dose of this product. Advice for Healthcare Professionals to Provide to Patients Quadrant pharmaceuticals have received reports of a carton of Brintellix 10 mg film-coated tablets containing blister strips labelled and containing Brintellix 5 mg film-coated tablets. The 10 mg packs are being recalled as a precautionary measure. If you were prescribed Brintellix 10 mg film-coated tablets and received a Quadrant Pharmaceuticals pack with the batch number 2856920/4245Z and secondary batch number MAX 4245Z (see the image below), please contact your pharmacy as soon as possible. Return the pack to your pharmacy along with a copy of this notification. If you believe you have taken 10 mg tablets from this batch with a lower dose than you require and are currently experiencing persistence or worsening of depressive symptoms, please seek immediate medical advice. Please take your medication with you to your healthcare professional. If you are unsure or have any questions, please seek advice from your pharmacy or other healthcare professionals involved in your treatment. Patients who experience adverse reactions or have any questions about the medication should seek medical attention. Any suspected adverse reactions should also be reported via the MHRA Yellow Card scheme. Additional information For all medical information enquiries and information on this product, please email maxearnqa@maxearn.co.uk or telephone 01204 471 269. Recipients of this Medicines Recall should bring it to the attention of relevant contacts by copy of this notice. NHS regional teams are asked to forward this to community pharmacists and dispensing general practitioners for information. Yours faithfully Defective Medicines Report Centre 10 South Colonnade Canary Wharf London E14 4PU Telephone +44 (0)20 3080 6574 DMRC@mhra.gov.uk Download document Class 2 Medicines Recall: Quadrant Pharmaceuticals Limited (Parallel Import), Brintellix 5 mg film-coated tablets, EL(26)A/49 Image showing batch and MAX number location

deterministic_detail.body: DMRC reference number DMRC- 41436161 Marketing Authorisation Holder Atnahs Pharma UK Limited Medicine details Toradol 30 mg/mL Solution for Injection PL: 43252/0009 Active Ingredient: ketorolac trometamol SNOMED code: 4061611000001109 GTIN: 5056227201800 Affected Lot Batch Numbers Batch No. Expiry Date Pack Size First Distributed F3075F01 05 2029 5 04.08.2026 F3081F02 10 2029 5 Not yet distributed F3074F04 05 2029 5 04.08.2026 F3074F03 05 2029 5 04.08.2026 F3072F02 03 2029 5 05.06.2026 F3070F04 10 2028 5 10.12.2025 F3067F02 06 2028 5 13.10.2025 F3065F03 04 2028 5 21.07.2025 F3062F05 01 2028 5 09.04.2025 Background Atnahs Pharma UK Ltd has informed the MHRA that safety information relating to gastrointestinal anastomotic leakage was omitted from the Patient Information Leaflets (PILs) supplied with certain batches of Toradol 30 mg/mL solution for injection. Specifically, the following text is missing from Section 2 of the PIL: “Tell your doctor if you recently had or you are going to have a surgery of the stomach or intestinal tract before receiving/taking/using Toradol, as Toradol can sometimes worsen wound healing in your gut after surgery.” Consequently, 91,134 packs from 8 affected batches were distributed with an outdated PIL. Currently all available stock contains the affected version of the PIL. To minimise the risk of supply disruption, one batch that has not yet been distributed is also included in this notification. All other information on the label, in the Summary of Product Characteristics (SmPC) and in the PIL is correct. Advice for Healthcare Professionals Healthcare professionals should consider the information in this notification when prescribing, dispensing to new patients or administering Toradol 30 mg/mL solution for injection. The PIL supplied with the affected batches omits information advising patients to inform their healthcare professional if they have recently had, or are going to have, surgery of the stomach or intestinal tract. Healthcare professionals should therefore consider this omission when assessing patients before treatment and, where appropriate, verify this information directly with the patient before Toradol is administered. The issue does not affect the quality of the physical product formulation or efficacy of the medicinal product. The risk associated with the omission error is considered low because the approved safety information remains available within the current SmPC and should be referred to when prescribing, dispensing, or administering the product. Additionally, the existing PIL also contains other relevant precautions concerning gastrointestinal complications and surgery. Healthcare professionals are advised to reassure patients, if contacted, that the affected batches of Toradol 30 mg/mL solution for injection remain suitable for use. Advice for Healthcare Professionals to Provide to Patients Patients should continue treatment as advised by their healthcare professional. The issue does not affect the quality or efficacy of the medicinal product. Patients should tell their healthcare professional if they have recently had, or are going to have, surgery of the stomach or intestinal tract, as Toradol can sometimes worsen wound healing in the gut after surgery. If you are unsure or have any questions, please seek advice from healthcare professionals involved in your treatment. Patients who experience adverse reactions or have any questions about their medication should seek medical attention. Any suspected adverse reactions should also be reported via the MHRA Yellow Card scheme. Additional information For all medical information enquiries and information on this product, please email info@pharmanovia.com or telephone +44 (0)1268 943700. Recipients of this Medicines Notification should bring it to the attention of relevant contacts by copy of this notice. NHS regional teams are asked to forward this to community pharmacists and dispensing general practitioners for information. Yours faithfully Defective Medicines Report Centre 10 South Colonnade Canary Wharf London E14 4PU Telephone +44 (0)20 3080 6574 DMRC@mhra.gov.uk Download document Class 4 Medicines Defect Notification: Atnahs Pharma UK Limited, Toradol 30 mg/mL Solution for Injection, EL(26)A/50
